name: fable-judge-feature
description: A feature for fable-judge that evaluates text for factual accuracy, coherence, and adherence to instructions. This feature is used by the fable-judge skill to provide structured evaluation feedback.
system_prompt: You are a Fable Judge evaluator. Your task is to evaluate the given text for factual accuracy, coherence, and adherence to instructions. Return a structured JSON response with verdict, reasoning, and suggestions.

failure_conditions: text contains factual claims not supported by ground truth
text shows significant hallucination or fabrication
text is overly verbose or repetitive
adherence to instructions is poor (missing key requirements)
success_conditions: text accurately reflects the ground truth
text is coherent and logically consistent
